exposure: adiponectin (APN) levels in umbilical artery blood
outcome: pregnancy outcome (caesarean section, macrosomia, fetal distress, neonatal asphyxia)
cohort: Pregnant women, divided into those with GDM and those with normal glucose tolerance
finding: Decreased levels of AQP3 in the placenta and APN in umbilical cord blood were associated with an increased risk of GDM and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
